result.title: On Lipschitz Explosion in Deep Neural Networks with Normalization: Consequences for Optimization and Adversarial Robustness
result.comment: The Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS) 2026
result.summary: Can a network look stable at every layer and still be exponentially unstable as a whole? The Lipschitz constant of a neural network is a basic stability quantity appearing in optimization guarantees, generalization bounds, and robustness certificates. Deep networks naturally admit two such notions, input Lipschitzness, measuring sensitivity to data perturbations, and parameter Lipschitzness, measuring sensitivity to weight perturbations. We prove that, for deep networks with normalization layers, with batch normalization as the canonical example, both Lipschitz constants can grow exponentially with depth and hence with parameter dimension, even under strong per-layer norm control such as $\|W_\ell\|_2\le 1$, and already for linear activations. Thus, a mechanism widely used to stabilize training can create severe worst-case instabilities that are invisible locally, i.e., from layerwise norm bounds alone. Parameter-Lipschitz explosion turns Lipschitz-dependent nonsmooth optimization guarantees into exponential-in-dimension bounds for deep normalized networks, while input-Lipschitz explosion makes worst-case Lipschitz-based generalization and robustness certificates vacuous. The latter also yields a concrete rank-separation mechanism for adversarial vulnerability. The theory predicts that perturbations introducing new singular directions should be amplified much more strongly than perturbations at the same noise level that remain within the input's original singular subspace. Experiments on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10 support this prediction, showing that rank-creating perturbations cause substantially sharper drops in accuracy, confidence, and margins than same-subspace perturbations.

AI.brief_summary: 论文证明含归一化层（如 BatchNorm）的深层网络即使在逐层范数受控、甚至线性激活下，输入与参数 Lipschitz 常数仍可随深度指数增长，使优化与鲁棒性证书失效，并提出「秩分离」机制解释对抗脆弱性，用 MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10 实验验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「引入新奇异方向的扰动被放大远强于同子空间扰动」的结论，可能为诊断 latent 视觉状态对细节扰动的稳定性、敏感性度量与视觉证据筛选提供参照，可供核查是否能用于 latent 推理轨迹的逐层不稳定分析。
